title: feat(k6fail): k=6 face fail on B16: t(12,0,0)=18 vs t(6,6,0)=14
science: The direct correction counterpart to #6757: same residual (k=6 face reverse, lex-first walks) run on B_16(0) instead of B_12(0), and the answer flips from YES to NO -- 23328 < 28224. Shows why: on B_16 the axis walk reaches (12,-1,0) (|v|_1=13, now in-ball) and pays only ONE cost-3 hop instead of the two forced on B_12, so t(12,0,0)=18 not 20. Also records a clean local fact: all six in-ball neighbours of (12,0,0) have incoming nu-cost 3, while four of the six neighbours of (6,6,0) cost 1.
verdict_pair: face reverse k=6 = NO on B_16 (23328<28224), contradicting the YES on B_12 in #6757
